android.desc: An AI app that helps you based on your day to day basis, which will answer any question that you want answered. No NSFW content will be tolerated and/or will be allowed, and neither will violence. It has features such as adjusting the way you want the AI to talk to you, or if you want to talk about something private to it, then you can access the private vault. But what if you want to talk to multiple AI models at once, to get their opinion on something. Council mode. NeoNexus isn't just that though. So many more features, waiting on you. Come join the newest and best upcoming AI today.

quotes.text: I'm building NeoNexus which is an AI agent that resolves every day conflicts, any day. NeoNexus queries five AI models simultaneously, lets them debate, and delivers a single judge-written verdict with dissenting views shown so users get more reliable answers than any one model gives alone. Key features of NeoNexus are Council Mode to convene up to 4 models on any question you want, and Model Arena to fight each LM in NeoNexus. Feedback would be nice, and if you want to take it to the next level buy a subscription! It's also on playstore so do check it out here if you have an android. Play Store Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.despia.neonexus
